assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Making the legacy path count as a delivery again makes _delivered_review_record return the predecessor round and promote_review_run_itself refuse nothing, so the None assertion and the promoted-is-false assertion both redden.
Reading the head from the legacy path or the any-head glob instead of the declared path writes the predecessor head or a null total onto the ledger row, so the two row assertions redden.
Dropping any one of the same_revision, review_run_id or dispatch-time checks lets the mismatched record deliver, so that case's None assertion reddens.
Removing the no-head refusal in recovery_review_acceptance.py:320 makes promote_review_run_itself promote on the legacy round, so the promoted-is-false and reason assertions redden.
